unit_note: the surface record is geopotential height in gpm; the mapping declares the explicit same-unit scale 1.0 to metres
time_policy: decoded at every valid time and required invariant
member_policy: the deterministic GDAS pgrb2 product carries no member axis in any probed message; the enkfgdas ensemble is a separate netCDF-only product whose member identity exists only in its S3 path
analysis_cycle_policy: the route this profile certifies is the hourly f000..f009 pgrb2.0p25 set, whose bytes stamp every hour -- including hour 0 -- a FORECAST (typeOfProcessedData fc, generating process 81 at hour 0 and 96 after); the one product stamped an ANALYSIS (pgrb2.1p00.anl) is a strict 610-record subset missing all soil, the land mask and every 2 m/10 m field, and is not an initialization route
field_set_parity: record-for-record byte-identical catalogue to GFS pgrb2.0p25 in the same order (696/696 at f000, 743/743 at f003, MEASURED 2026-08-17 06Z); nothing in the GRIB metadata distinguishes a GDAS file from a GFS file -- only the acquisition path says which it is
input_identity: dynamic file paths and SHA-256 values are owned by gpuwm-mapped-composition-inputs-v1
